raw_text: It can be really tough to have that conversation, especially when he's not taking responsibility for his actions. Finding hobbies or activities that bring you joy can be a great way to take your mind off things and focus on yourself. It might also be helpful to talk to a therapist or counselor who can provide you with a safe and supportive space to process your emotions and work through your feelings. Would you like some suggestions for hobbies or activities that might be a good fit for you?
